entry.title: New: Bill 124, CD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES; AND DEPARTMENT OF FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY, FIRE/RESCUE OPERATIONS PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget by: 1) amending Section 2, Estimated Revenues, by increasing Carryover/Savings from the General Fund by $2,000,000; 2) amending Section 3.B.6.c, Department of Fire and Public Safety, Fire/Rescue Operations Program by increasing Category B (Operations & Equipment) and Total appropriations by $2,000,000; and 3) adjusting the totals accordingly.
